paper.title: The genetics of caloric restriction in Caenorhabditis elegans

organism.source_quote: To understand better how caloric restriction lengthens life span, we used genetic methods and criteria to investigate its mechanism of action in the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans.

strain.source_quote: the wild type (N2) was always included as a control

sex.source_quote: experiments were begun by allowing adult hermaphrodites to lay eggs for a limited time (4-6 hr)

sample_size.source_quote: Experiments were started with 50 experimental worms per genotype (10 per plate) and the wild type (N2) was always included as a control.

type.source_quote: Mutations in many genes (eat genes) result in partial starvation of the worm by disrupting the function of the pharynx, the feeding organ.

agent.source_quote: the strain DA465 eat-2(ad465) was used without backcrosses in experiments testing the interaction of eat-2 with daf-16, daf-2, and clk-1

mechanism.source_quote: This observation, along with the other evidence presented, indicates that eat genes indeed lengthen life span by reducing food intake and presumably caloric intake.

direction.source_quote: We found that most eat mutations significantly lengthen life span (by up to 50%).

mean_change_pct.source_quote: eat-2(ad465) has been determined seven times, and in every trial mutants live substantially longer than the wild type, with an average lengthening of life span of 47% over the wild type

p_value.source_quote: MQ594 eat-2(ad465): n=50, mean 25.1 +/- 0.7 days, +29% vs wild type, P < 0.0005 (Table 1, Experiment 2)

experiments.notes: Genetic model of caloric restriction: eat-2 disrupts pharyngeal pumping, causing partial starvation; recorded mechanism is CR as stated by the authors. Scope decision: one record for the headline intervention (eat-2, reference allele ad465, mean +47% over 7 trials); other significant eat genes (eat-1, -3, -6, -13, -18) and allele-level variation (ad453 +36%, ad1113 +46%, ad1116 +57% in Experiment 2, where ad465 showed +29%) not recorded as separate experiments. p_value taken from Table 1 for ad465 (Experiment 2), a single trial, while mean_change_pct is the seven-trial average. Maximum lifespan also lengthened per text but no percentage given. Cultured at 20C. Epistasis results (daf-16-independent; eat-2;daf-2 additive; eat-2;clk-1 non-additive) support CR being distinct from insulin/dauer pathway.
